awkNote.id: A1 adalah peningkatan tunggal terbaik untuk Main DPS maupun sub DPS karena Ultimate kedua menghabiskan semua Malice. A4 menambah uptime buff ATK tim, dan A5 paling berguna bila seluruh tim bertipe Lakshana, Psyche, atau Chaos.
awkNote.en: A1 is the best single upgrade for both main and sub DPS because her second Ultimate consumes all Malice. A4 raises the uptime of her team ATK buff, and A5 shines when the whole team is Lakshana, Psyche or Chaos.

faq.id: Ascend (Lv 20 ke 80) butuh total 525.000 Beetle Coins dan 86× Colorful Ticket Stub. Max level ability butuh 1.748.000 Beetle Coins. Gift Bond termurah: Gubicrisp.
faq.en: Ascension (Lv 20 to 80) costs 525,000 Beetle Coins and 86× Colorful Ticket Stub. Maxing abilities costs 1,748,000 Beetle Coins. Cheapest Bond gift: Gubicrisp.

awkNote.id: Awakening yang menambah damage didahulukan dan satu-satunya yang bersifat bertahan (A1) paling akhir. A3 menguatkan skill klik dan memperbesar medan emasnya, A2 hampir selalu aktif. Resonance 3 dan 6 sangat bernilai karena menambah satu pemakaian skill kuat per rotasi.
awkNote.en: Damage Awakenings come first and her only defensive one (A1) comes last. A3 boosts her click skill and widens the golden field, A2 is almost always active. Resonance 3 and 6 are very valuable because they add one extra enhanced skill per rotation.

faq.id: Ascend (20 ke 80) butuh 86× Charging Knight Spark Plug. Max seluruh ability memakan 40× Synchronicity of Thought.
faq.en: Ascension (20 to 80) costs 86× Charging Knight Spark Plug. Maxing all abilities takes 40× Synchronicity of Thought.

awkNote.id: A5 untuk damage mentah (Lacrimosa DPS), A6 untuk utilitas (sub DPS yang memicu Esper Cycle tanpa mengumpulkan rate). A4, A3, dan A1 saling menguatkan di sekitar Nightmare; untuk Lacrimosa DPS, A4 atau A3 biasanya lebih baik daripada A6.
awkNote.en: A5 for raw damage (DPS Lacrimosa), A6 for utility (a sub DPS who triggers Esper Cycles without building rate). A4, A3 and A1 reinforce each other around Nightmare; for a DPS Lacrimosa, A4 or A3 is usually better than A6.

faq.id: Fokus mekaniknya menumpuk Nightmare (maks 10 stack) lalu memecahkannya. Material ascend utama 86× Confessional Flower Seed. Gift Bond terbaik: Tomato 100.
faq.en: Her mechanic is stacking Nightmare (max 10 stacks) and then breaking it. Main ascension material: 86× Confessional Flower Seed. Best Bond gift: Tomato 100.

awkNote.id: A5 terbaik (Break paksa dan Break DMG tim, apalagi bersama Daffodill). A2 menguatkan Ultimate dan membuat A4 jauh lebih baik, jadi A4 diambil setelah A2. A6 lebih bernilai bila Zankou Main DPS, bahkan bisa jadi pilihan ketiga; A3 hanya bertahan.
awkNote.en: A5 is best (forced Break and team Break DMG, especially with Daffodill). A2 powers up her Ultimate and makes A4 much better, so take A4 after A2. A6 is worth more as Main DPS and can even be the third pick; A3 is defensive only.

faq.id: Ascend butuh 86× Nest Guard Fragment. Gift termurah untuk max Bond: 280× Serenade.
faq.en: Ascension needs 86× Nest Guard Fragment. Cheapest gift to max Bond: 280× Serenade.

awkNote.id: Dua pilihan pertama sudah jelas: A6 dan A5, pilih sesuai kebutuhan tim (A5 untuk tim yang bergantung pada Esper Cycle). A1 lalu A4 menambah damage; A3 dan A2 lebih kecil dan terutama memperlancar rotasi.
awkNote.en: The first two are clear: A6 and A5, pick by team need (A5 for teams that rely on Esper Cycles). A1 then A4 add damage; A3 and A2 are smaller and mainly smooth the rotation.

faq.id: Ascend butuh 86× Water Moon Pick. Kit-nya berpusat pada trigger Synced Strike (follow-up) bersama rekan tim.
faq.en: Ascension needs 86× Water Moon Pick. Her kit centres on Synced Strike (follow-up) triggers with teammates.

awkNote.id: Kamu akan mendapat semua Awakening Zero, jadi jangan terlalu dipusingkan. A2 pertama (pemulihan energi Ultimate), lalu A3. A1 dan A6 hanya aktif melawan musuh yang levelnya lebih rendah sehingga hampir tidak berguna di konten utama.
awkNote.en: You will get all of Zero's Awakenings, so do not stress. A2 first (Ultimate energy recovery), then A3. A1 and A6 only trigger against lower-level enemies, so they are nearly useless in main content.

faq.id: Material utama: 86× Charging Knight Spark Plug.
faq.en: Main material: 86× Charging Knight Spark Plug.

awkNote.id: Hanya sebagian Awakening Iroi yang menambah damage tim: A5 terbaik, lalu A2 dan A1. A4 hanya berguna bila Iroi dipakai sebagai DPS; A3 dan A6 bersifat penyembuhan dan jarang dibutuhkan di konten akhir, jadi ambil sesuai kebutuhan.
awkNote.en: Only some of Iroi's Awakenings add team damage: A5 is best, then A2 and A1. A4 only helps if Iroi is used as a DPS; A3 and A6 are healing-focused and rarely needed in endgame, so take them as needed.

faq.id: Ascend butuh 86× A Page from Delusion's Shore. Ultimate-nya memberi buff DMG besar setiap ia menyembuhkan.
faq.en: Ascension needs 86× A Page from Delusion's Shore. Her Ultimate gives a big DMG buff every time she heals.

awkNote.id: A4 sangat disarankan karena menggandakan buff ATK tim setelah Ultimate. A5 situasional karena tidak semua musuh bisa dilempar ke udara. Sisanya kecil karena peran Sakiri bukan menyerang.
awkNote.en: A4 is highly recommended because it doubles the team ATK buff after her Ultimate. A5 is situational because not every enemy can be launched. The rest are minor since Sakiri's role is not damage.

faq.id: Butuh 86× Charging Knight Spark Plug. Gift Bond paling worth it: Crave Bites! Milk Flavor.
faq.en: Needs 86× Charging Knight Spark Plug. Best-value Bond gift: Crave Bites! Milk Flavor.

awkNote.id: A6 menambah satu pemakaian mekanik utamanya (Final Verdict) dan membuka jendela burst baru. A1 menambah konsistensi, A2 menambah damage terhadap target ber-Warrant; A5 lebih unggul untuk boss, A3 untuk gerombolan. A4 hampir tidak berdampak.
awkNote.en: A6 adds an extra use of his core mechanic (Final Verdict) and opens a new burst window. A1 adds consistency and A2 adds damage against Warrant targets; A5 is better for bosses, A3 for groups. A4 has almost no impact.

faq.id: Butuh 86× Tear of the Sea. Mekaniknya mengumpulkan Crime hingga penuh lalu melepasnya sebagai Settlement DMG.
faq.en: Needs 86× Tear of the Sea. Her mechanic is filling Crime and releasing it as Settlement DMG.

awkNote.id: A1 biasanya pertama bila hanya punya satu copy, tetapi dengan dua copy A3 + A5 memberi damage lebih besar karena saling menguatkan. A4 makin baik bila A2 sudah ada. A6 terutama kenyamanan di luar pertarungan.
awkNote.en: A1 is usually first if you only have one copy, but with two copies A3 + A5 gives more damage because they feed each other. A4 gets better once A2 is in. A6 is mostly out-of-combat comfort.

faq.id: Ascend butuh 86× A Page from Delusion's Shore. Gift Bond paling hemat: Cool-lala Spicy Snack.
faq.en: Ascension needs 86× A Page from Delusion's Shore. Most economical Bond gift: Cool-lala Spicy Snack.

awkNote.id: A3 memudahkan rotasi dan A2 sedikit lebih besar untuk damage murni; A4 hanya layak diambil bila A3 sudah ada. A5 bersifat bertahan.
awkNote.en: A3 makes rotations easier and A2 is slightly larger for pure damage; A4 is only worth taking once A3 is in. A5 is defensive.

faq.id: Butuh 86× Charging Knight Spark Plug. Sangat kuat di single target karena burst DMG dan skala CRIT-nya.
faq.en: Needs 86× Charging Knight Spark Plug. Very strong against single targets thanks to its burst DMG and CRIT scaling.

awkNote.id: Daffodill itu unik karena beberapa Awakening saling menguatkan. A5 selalu yang pertama. A3 membuat Insight tidak terhapus dan bisa menumpuk, sedangkan A4 menambah damage per stack Insight, jadi ambil A4 setelah A3, bukan sebelumnya. Kombinasi A5 + A3 adalah yang terbaik bila punya dua copy, dan menambahkan A4 membuatnya lebih tinggi lagi.
awkNote.en: Daffodill is unique because several Awakenings reinforce each other. A5 is always first. A3 stops Insight from being removed and lets it stack, while A4 adds damage per Insight stack, so take A4 after A3, not before. A5 + A3 is the best two-copy combo, and adding A4 raises it further.

faq.id: Ascend butuh 86× Charging Knight Spark Plug. Sangat berfokus pada Break.
faq.en: Ascension needs 86× Charging Knight Spark Plug. Heavily focused on Break.

awkNote.id: A6 dan A3 diambil pertama. A5 memberi buff tim hanya saat melawan satu musuh (pilih A5 untuk single target, A1 bila ingin yang selalu aktif), dan A4 hanya berguna di AoE.
awkNote.en: A6 and A3 come first. A5 buffs the team only against a single enemy (pick A5 for single target, A1 if you want something always active), and A4 only helps in AoE.

faq.id: Mekaniknya memakai Time Stop lalu memutar ulang skill rekan tim. Ascend butuh 86× Confessional Flower Seed.
faq.en: Her mechanic uses Time Stop and replays teammates' skills. Ascension needs 86× Confessional Flower Seed.

faq.id: Memberi pasif ATK tim berdasarkan Base ATK-nya sendiri. Ascend butuh 86× Nest Guard Fragment.
faq.en: Gives a team ATK passive based on her own Base ATK. Ascension needs 86× Nest Guard Fragment.

awkNote.id: Sudah bagus tanpa copy tambahan. A1 mempercepat penumpukan Power Word, A6 menambah Crit Rate, A2 menambah ATK; tiga lainnya terutama kenyamanan. A5 baru berguna bila kamu punya Resonance 6.
awkNote.en: Already good with no extra copies. A1 speeds up Power Word stacking, A6 adds Crit Rate, A2 adds ATK; the other three are mostly comfort. A5 only matters if you reach Resonance 6.

faq.id: Mengorbankan sebagian HP sendiri untuk menumpuk Power Word demi ledakan Ultimate. Ascend butuh 86× Nest Guard Fragment.
faq.en: Sacrifices some of her own HP to stack Power Word for an Ultimate burst. Ascension needs 86× Nest Guard Fragment.

awkNote.id: A2 jelas yang pertama (menguatkan Lethal Rose Pact dan menyembuhkan tim), A6 kedua terutama melawan boss dan musuh elit. A1 paling akhir karena butuh minimal tiga target.
awkNote.en: A2 is clearly first (strengthens Lethal Rose Pact and heals the team), A6 second especially against bosses and elites. A1 is last because it needs at least three targets.

faq.id: Unit revolver yang juga bisa menyembuhkan pada tingkat Awakening tertentu. Ascend butuh 86× Tear of the Sea.
faq.en: A revolver unit that can also heal at certain Awakening levels. Ascension needs 86× Tear of the Sea.

faq.id: Ascend butuh 86× Water Moon Pick. Kemampuan utamanya berputar pada Blessing Shield dan menumpuk Karma.
faq.en: Ascension needs 86× Water Moon Pick. Her core revolves around Blessing Shield and stacking Karma.

awkNote.id: Tentukan dulu fokusnya: damage pribadi atau utilitas tim. A5 mengubah cara membangunnya dan memberi lonjakan besar di wujud Lilith; A1 membuat rekan yang sedang di lapangan lebih tahan. Urutan bisa berubah saat perhitungan sumbernya selesai.
awkNote.en: Decide your focus first: personal damage or team utility. A5 changes how you build her and gives a big spike in Lilith form; A1 makes the on-field ally sturdier. The order may change once the source finishes its calculations.

faq.id: Menyerap damage yang diterima rekan ke dirinya (redirect). Ascend butuh 86× Water Moon Pick.
faq.en: Absorbs damage taken by teammates onto herself (redirect). Ascension needs 86× Water Moon Pick.

awkNote.id: Dengan dua copy, ambil A1 + A3 dulu: A3 memberi stack Optical Illusion yang dibutuhkan A1. Kalau hanya satu, A4 adalah yang terkuat. Kombinasi A1 + A3 menuntut satu serangan kuat tambahan sehingga waktu di lapangan lebih lama.
awkNote.en: With two copies take A1 + A3 first: A3 supplies the Optical Illusion stacks that A1 needs. With only one, A4 is the strongest. The A1 + A3 combo needs one extra strong attack, so it costs more field time.

faq.id: Karakter baru v1.5. Memakai jenjang Connection Strength dan memberi bonus tim besar setelah Ultimate. Ascend butuh 86× Tear of the Sea.
faq.en: New in v1.5. Uses Connection Strength tiers and gives a big team bonus after her Ultimate. Ascension needs 86× Tear of the Sea.

faq.id: Rilis di banner Offline Equations v1.5 Phase 2 (2 Desember 2026), jadi data masih pra-rilis. Mekaniknya mengumpulkan Frames untuk memanggil Digital Echo yang bertarung bersamanya. Ascend butuh 86× Confessional Flower Seed.
faq.en: Releases on the Offline Equations banner, v1.5 Phase 2 (December 2, 2026), so the data is pre-release. Her mechanic collects Frames to summon a Digital Echo that fights alongside her. Ascension needs 86× Confessional Flower Seed.

awkNote.id: Chiz gratis, jadi semua Awakening-nya akan kamu dapat; urutan bisa berubah saat perhitungan sumbernya selesai. A2 dan A4 mempercepat pengumpulan Grain, A1 menambah kapasitas, dan A5 membuka pertarungan dengan penyimpanan penuh.
awkNote.en: Chiz is free, so you will get every Awakening; the order may change once the source finishes its calculations. A2 and A4 gather Grain faster, A1 raises capacity and A5 opens combat with full storage.

faq.id: Damage ceiling sangat tinggi, tetapi menuntut penguasaan mekanik Grain dengan eksekusi sempurna.
faq.en: Very high damage ceiling, but demands mastery of the Grain mechanic with perfect execution.

awkNote.id: A2 dan A1 dipilih pertama karena memperbaiki siklus stack-nya. A3 menambah damage terhadap musuh non-boss, jadi kuat di AoE walau tampak kecil dalam hitungan melawan boss; aktifkan atau matikan sesuai pertarungan single target atau AoE.
awkNote.en: A2 and A1 come first because they fix her stack loop. A3 adds damage against non-boss enemies, so it is strong in AoE even though it looks small in boss calculations; toggle it on or off depending on single-target or AoE fights.

faq.id: Mirip Emergency Delivery (Thorn Motorcycle) untuk Burst AoE dan Energy recharge tim.
faq.en: Similar to Emergency Delivery (Thorn Motorcycle) for AoE burst and team energy recharge.

faq.id: Psyche DPS yang bisa didapat gratis; pasif Crescendo menumpuk ATK setiap serangan. Awakening 6 wajib.
faq.en: A free Psyche DPS; her Crescendo passive stacks ATK on every hit. Awakening 6 is a must.

faq.id: Ketahanan di lapangan cukup baik dengan rantai Ultimate, tetapi kalah DPS dibanding S-Rank. Butuh A6 untuk konten endgame.
faq.en: Decent on-field durability with her chained Ultimates, but behind S-rank DPS. Needs A6 for endgame content.

faq.id: Fokusnya pada Fang Thrusts yang melacak dan mengunci target agar Crowd Control lebih mudah. Bersinergi dengan Baicang saat Stealth. Butuh A6.
faq.en: Focuses on Fang Thrusts that track and lock targets for easier Crowd Control. Synergises with Baicang during Stealth. Needs A6.

faq.id: Bergantung pada pemulihan berkelanjutan Wild Current; akan tergantikan setelah kamu punya Iroi atau Jiuyuan. Butuh A6 untuk utilitas tinggi.
faq.en: Relies on the sustained recovery of Wild Current; replaced once you own Iroi or Jiuyuan. Needs A6 for high utility.

awkNote.id: Kamu akan mendapat semua Awakening Zero, jadi jangan terlalu dipusingkan. A2 pertama (pemulihan energi Ultimate), lalu A3. A1 dan A6 hanya aktif melawan musuh yang levelnya lebih rendah sehingga hampir tidak berguna di konten utama.
awkNote.en: You will get all of Zero's Awakenings, so do not stress. A2 first (Ultimate energy recovery), then A3. A1 and A6 only trigger against lower-level enemies, so they are nearly useless in main content.

faq.id: Material utama: 86× Charging Knight Spark Plug.
faq.en: Main material: 86× Charging Knight Spark Plug.
